messages.content:
Upgrade the authentication and login system to an industry-standard architecture.

Do NOT allow anonymous access to admin or authorized dashboards.

Implement the following authentication model:

1. ADMIN
- Secure login with username/email and password.
- JWT authentication.
- Role: ADMIN.
- Full access to all modules.

2. AUTHORIZED USERS
Implement secure login for authorized personnel only.

Roles should include:
- Disaster Management Officer
- Police
- Fire Department
- Hospital Staff
- Rescue Team
- Volunteer Coordinator
- NGO Coordinator

Each role must have its own permissions.

Implement RBAC (Role-Based Access Control).

3. PUBLIC CITIZENS
Do NOT require login.

Citizens should be able to:

- Report a disaster
- Upload photos/videos
- Enter their name
- Enter mobile number
- Enter email (optional)
- Share GPS location
- Track the status of their own report using a generated Report ID

Citizens must NOT have access to:
- Admin Dashboard
- Analytics
- User Management
- Rescue Teams
- Resource Management
- Hospitals
- Shelters
- Audit Logs
- System Settings

4. LOGIN PAGE

Redesign the login page professionally.

The page should contain:

- Government Disaster Management branding
- Modern Material UI design
- Professional background image or subtle animated gradient
- Glassmorphism login card
- Responsive layout
- Password visibility toggle
- Remember Me
- Forgot Password
- Role selection (Admin / Authorized Personnel)

Below the login card, add a prominent button:

"Report Disaster (No Login Required)"

Clicking it should navigate directly to the public disaster reporting page.

5. PUBLIC DISASTER REPORT PAGE

Create a separate page that requires no authentication.

The form should include:
- Reporter Name
- Mobile Number
- Email (optional)
- Disaster Type
- Severity
- Description
- Address
- GPS Coordinates
- Upload Images
- Upload Videos
- Submit

After submission:
- Generate a unique Report ID.
- Show a success confirmation.
- Allow the user to track the report later using the Report ID.

6. SECURITY

Protect every admin and authorized route with JWT.

Unauthorized users must be redirected to the login page.

Implement proper role-based authorization on both frontend and backend.

7. TESTING

Verify:
- Admin login works.
- Authorized user login works.
- Public users can report disasters without logging in.
- Report tracking works.
- Unauthorized access is blocked.
- No console errors.
- No runtime errors.

Upgrade the Disaster Reporting module.

Improve:

- Better disaster form
- Image upload
- Multiple images
- Video attachment support
- PDF attachment support
- Drag-and-drop upload

Improve validation.

Improve search.

Improve filtering.

Improve pagination.

Improve sorting.

Improve status workflow.

Add comments.

Add assignment history.

Add disaster priority.

Improve timeline.

Improve backend architecture.

Verify every CRUD operation.

Test everything.

Upgrade the Disaster Management platform to industry-standard authentication (JWT + RBAC, protected admin/authorized routes, public citizen reporting without login) and enrich the Disaster Reporting module (priority, attachments, comments, assignment history, timeline, search/filter/sort/pagination, status workflow validation).

## Important Details
- Stack: Spring Boot 3.2.0 backend (Java 17, Maven, H2 in PostgreSQL mode, Flyway `V1__init_schema.sql` … `Vn__*.sql`), React 18 + Vite 5 + MUI 9 + react-router-dom 6 + axios frontend (`/api` proxied to `localhost:8080`).
- RBAC already exists: `Permissions.java` constants; `RbacService` maps roles → permissions; `JwtResponse` returns `permissions`; `@PreAuthorize("@rbacService.hasPermission(...)")` used on controllers.
- Roles in `Role.java`: `ADMIN, DMO, POLICE, FIRE_DEPARTMENT, HOSPITAL_STAFF, RESCUE_TEAM, VOLUNTEER_COORDINATOR, NGO_COORDINATOR, USER`.
- `DisasterStatus`: `PENDING, VERIFIED, ASSIGNED, RESOURCES_DISPATCHED, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED`.
- Status transition validation added in `DisasterService.ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS` (RESOLVED is terminal; invalid transitions throw `IllegalArgumentException`).
- Public report flow: no auth, returns generated `reportId` (`DMS-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX`), marks `source="PUBLIC"`, notifies all administrators, sends SMS/email confirmation.
- JWT config: `app.jwt.secret`, `expiration-ms=86400000`, `refresh-expiration-ms=604800000`.
- Backend compiled clean (`mvn -q -DskipTests compile`) *before* the latest DisasterAttachment files were added — recompile needed.

## Work State
### Completed
- Baseline build verified: backend `mvn compile` OK; frontend `npm run build` OK (chunk-size warning only).
- Backend entities: `DisasterPriority` enum; `DisasterComment`; `DisasterAssignment`; `Disaster` + `priority` + `pdfUrls`; `DisasterAttachment` (Category IMAGE/VIDEO/PDF, `@Lob dataUrl` CLOB).
- Backend repositories: `DisasterCommentRepository`, `DisasterAssignmentRepository`, `DisasterAttachmentRepository`; `DisasterRepository` now extends `JpaSpecificationExecutor`.
- Backend DTOs: `PageResponse<T>`, `DisasterCommentDTO`, `CommentRequest`, `DisasterAssignmentDTO`, `AttachmentDTO`; `DisasterRequest`/`DisasterResponse`/`PublicDisasterReportRequest`/`PublicReportDTO` extended with priority + pdfUrls.
- Migration `V3__disaster_enrichment.sql`: `priority`, `pdf_urls` columns + `disaster_comments`, `disaster_assignments` tables + indexes.
- `DisasterService` rewritten: create (auth'd), `queryDisasters(...)` via `Specification<Disaster>` (search/type/severity/status/priority/source + page/size/sortBy/sortDir, safe size 1–100), status updates with workflow validation + timeline + notifications, comments CRUD, assignment history, public report/timeline, report ID generation.
- `DisasterController` rewritten: `/api/disasters` paged query, `/my`, `/{id}`, `/{id}/timeline`, `/{id}/status`, `POST/GET /{id}/comments`, `DELETE /comments/{commentId}`, `GET /{id}/assignments`.
- `PublicDisasterController`: added `GET /{reportId}/timeline` (no auth).
- `RescueTeamServiceImpl`: injects `DisasterService`; records `ASSIGNED`/`RELEASED` history in `assignToDisaster`/`updateTeamStatus`.
- Frontend `api.js` rewritten: `api` instance with refresh-token queue interceptor; `publicApi` (no auth, no redirect); `authApi` (+refresh/logout/verify/forgot/reset); `publicReportApi`; `disasterApi` + query params/comments/assignments/timeline; `userApi`, `rescueTeamApi`, etc.
- `AuthContext.jsx`: `persistUser`, `hasPermission`, `hasAnyPermission`, logout clears both storages and calls `authApi.logout`.
- `ProtectedRoute.jsx`: supports `adminOnly` and `permission` props with 401/403 redirects.
- `Login.jsx` rewritten: animated gradient + grid overlay, glassmorphism card, Admin/Authorized Personnel toggle, password visibility, Remember Me, Forgot Password link, demo buttons, "Report Disaster (No Login Required)" CTA → `/public-report`, "Track a submitted report" → `/track-report`, emergency helpline footer.
- `ForgotPassword.jsx` and `ResetPassword.jsx` created.

### Active
- Wiring `DisasterAttachment` into `DisasterService`/DTO flow (created entity/repo/DTO, but the service still stores only legacy CSV URL arrays — attachment persistence isn't wired into create/detail yet).
- Frontend pages not yet created/upgraded: `PublicReport.jsx`, `TrackReport.jsx`, `ReportDisaster.jsx` upgrade, `DisasterList.jsx` upgrade, `Sidebar.jsx` permission-based menu, `AdminDashboard.jsx` alignment.
- `App.jsx` routes not yet updated for public pages + RBAC-aware guards.

### Blocked

## Next Move
1. Recompile backend (`mvn -q -DskipTests compile`) to validate the new `DisasterAttachment`/`AttachmentDTO` files; fix any errors.
2. Wire attachments into `DisasterService.createDisaster` / `createPublicReport` / `getDisaster` (persist `DisasterAttachment` rows, expose metadata optionally with data URL) and add migration `V4__disaster_attachments.sql`.
3. Create `frontend/src/pages/PublicReport.jsx` (no-login form, drag-drop multi image/video/PDF upload, GPS, success Report ID) and `TrackReport.jsx`.
4. Update `App.jsx` routes (`/public-report`, `/track-report`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password`, permission-prop-driven protected routes).
5. Rewrite `Sidebar.jsx` menu from `user.permissions`; upgrade `ReportDisaster.jsx`, `DisasterList.jsx`, and align `AdminDashboard.jsx`.
6. Rebuild frontend (`npm run build`) and smoke-test auth flows + public reporting.

- `frontend/src/services/api.js`: refresh-token interceptor, `publicApi`, publicReportApi, disasterApi query/comment/assignment methods.
- `frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx`: redesigned auth page (glassmorphism, role toggle, public CTA).
- `frontend/src/pages/ForgotPassword.jsx`, `frontend/src/pages/ResetPassword.jsx`: new pages.
- `frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.jsx`, `context/AuthContext.jsx`: RBAC-aware guards/state.
